subject.title: fix: require decimal numeric oc-path predicates

question: Should relational oc-path predicates retain the documented finite-number coercion contract, or intentionally adopt a new plain-decimal-only grammar?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but changing a documented CLI predicate language can break existing scripts and cannot be selected safely from implementation preference alone.

options.title: Retain finite-number semantics
options.body: Keep `Number(...)` plus finite checks for relational predicates and limit any repair to a demonstrated coercion bug without changing the documented grammar.

options.title: Adopt plain-decimal grammar
options.body: Approve the compatibility change, update the public oc-path grammar documentation, and add a clear migration/release-note explanation with comprehensive accepted-form coverage.

recommendation.title: Retain finite-number semantics
recommendation.body: Keep `Number(...)` plus finite checks for relational predicates and limit any repair to a demonstrated coercion bug without changing the documented grammar.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct engagement and this is a user-facing predicate-language contract choice.
